status: 초안 — 페이지에서 쓰지 않는다. 연방(FLSA) 숫자만, 주(州) 최저임금은 다루지 않음(us.md 주의)

sources.label: U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division — Minimum Wage
sources.quote: The federal minimum wage is $7.25 per hour effective July 24, 2009. … Some state laws provide greater employee protections; employers must comply with both.

sources.label: U.S. DOL WHD Fact Sheet #15: Tipped Employees Under the FLSA
sources.quote: An employer must pay a tipped worker at least $2.13 per hour under the FLSA. … The maximum tip credit that an employer can currently claim is $5.12 per hour … customarily and regularly receive more than $30 a month in tips

sources.label: eCFR 29 CFR 531.50, 531.57, 531.59 (up to date as of 2026-10-16)
sources.quote: 531.50(a)(1) cash wage … not be less than the cash wage required … on August 20, 1996 [i.e., $2.13]; 531.59(a) tip credit = minimum wage required by section 6(a)(1) minus cash wage paid (at least $2.13); if tips are less than the tip credit the employer pays the balance

sources.label: U.S. DOL WHD Fact Sheet #23: Overtime Pay Requirements of the FLSA (Revised October 2019)
sources.quote: overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 in a workweek at a rate not less than time and one-half their regular rates of pay … Averaging of hours over two or more weeks is not permitted.

sources.label: eCFR 29 CFR 778.104, 778.105, 778.107 (up to date as of 2026-10-16)
sources.quote: 778.105 workweek = fixed and regularly recurring period of 168 hours — seven consecutive 24-hour periods; 778.107 not less than one and one-half times the regular rate, regular rate may in no event be less than the statutory minimum; 778.104 no averaging over 2 or more weeks

tipped.rule: tip credit = 7.25 − cash wage(≥ 2.13). 실제 팁이 tip credit 보다 적으면 사업주가 모자란 만큼 더 줘서 시급 7.25 를 맞춤(531.59)

salaryToHourly.source: eCFR 29 CFR 778.113 (up to date as of 2026-10-16) https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-29/section-778.113 (API: /api/versioner/v1/full/2026-10-16/title-29.xml?part=778&section=778.113) — checkedOn 2026-10-21
salaryToHourly.weekly: regular rate = 주급 ÷ 그 주급이 보상하려는 시간

월급 환산 대안(778.113(b) 끝 — 근무일 기준 식, 7(g)(3) 약정)의 조건: 문단을 끝까지 읽지 않음 — 페이지는 12 ÷ 52 식만 쓸 것
note: 월급 → 시급 환산은 778.113(b) 12 ÷ 52 식이 원문에 있음(월 $1,560·주 40시간 → $9). 한국 최저임금(월 209시간·주휴수당)과 1:1 대응이 아님 — 미국은 주 40시간 넘는 시간에 1.5배(초과근무) 기준이고 주휴 개념 없음. 2009-07-24 뒤 연방 금액 변경 없음(DOL 문장 기준). 연방 계약직(EO 14026)·면제 근로자(white-collar exemption) 급여 기준은 이 파일 밖
